hero.title: Understand your job offer before you sign
hero.subtitle: Upload a job offer or employment contract. Bayanuk extracts the important terms, explains them in plain language, and highlights the clauses that deserve attention.
hero.privacy: Your document is never used to train AI, and you can delete it yourself at any time.
hero.photoAlt: A person leafing through the pages of a long contract

graduates.title: Fresh graduates
graduates.body: First job offer, little experience with contract terms.
graduates.photoAlt: Two people reviewing the terms of an employment contract

switchers.title: Job switchers
switchers.body: Comparing a new offer to their current job or to a second offer.
switchers.photoAlt: A handshake over an employment contract

supportedFiles.title: Supported documents
supportedFiles.subtitle: Job offers and employment contracts, in Arabic and English.

contract.title: Employment contract
contract.body: Usually 5 to 30 pages, with richer clauses and risk points.

other.title: Not supported
other.body: Freelance contracts, NDAs, internship agreements, rental and commercial contracts.

supportedFiles.limits: PDF or Word (DOCX), up to 10 MB and 30 pages.

upload.title: Upload your document
upload.body: A PDF or Word file. We check its type, size and page count before anything else.

process.title: We read it
process.body: We read the document, extract the key terms, and look for points that need attention.

result.title: See the result
result.body: An overview, then key-term cards for pay, working hours, leave and contract, then attention points, then the summary.

ask.title: Ask your document
ask.body: Suggested questions such as “What is my notice period?” and “Can I resign during probation?”. Every answer cites the page and a short quote.

training.title: Never used for training
training.body: Documents are never used to train AI models.

masking.title: Personal details masked
masking.body: National ID, iqama number, IBAN and phone number are not extracted, and are masked before text is sent to the AI provider.

storage.title: Private, encrypted storage
storage.body: Files are stored privately and encrypted at rest, and are reached only through short-lived signed links.

delete.title: Deleted immediately
delete.body: Deleting a document removes the file, extracted text, analysis and chat history immediately.

retention.title: Deleted automatically
retention.body: You can delete your document at any time. It is deleted automatically after 24 hours for guests, and after 30 days for signed-in users unless they choose to keep it.

legal.question: Is Bayanuk legal advice?
legal.answer: No. Bayanuk provides AI-generated information to help you understand your document. It is not legal advice.

documents.question: Which documents does Bayanuk support?
documents.answer: Job offers and employment contracts, in Arabic and English, as a PDF or Word file up to 10 MB and 30 pages. Any other contract is declined with a clear message.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: No. You can upload and see the result without an account. Sign in to save the analysis and ask more: guests get 3 questions per document, signed-in users get 20.

signIn.question: How do I sign in?
signIn.answer: With a link sent to your email, or with your Google account.

answers.question: Where do the answers to my questions come from?
answers.answer: Only from your document, and every answer cites the page and a short quote. If the answer is not in the document, we say so clearly instead of guessing.

footer.disclaimer: Bayanuk provides AI-generated information to help you understand your document. It is not legal advice.
